Humanoid robots are taking combat skills to the next level. Two humanoid robots traded punches, kicks and blocks before a packed audience at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre. Standing 1.73 metres tall and weighing 75 kilograms each, the robots demonstrated powerful strikes, rapid attack-defence transitions and the ability to recover quickly after being knocked down. Their makers claim the machines pack more explosive power than the average adult male.
